faq.q: What types of photo booths do you offer?
faq.a: We offer open-air booths, enclosed booths and 360 booths. Open-air booths are great for big groups, enclosed booths give a private, classic booth feel, and 360 booths capture slow-motion video as guests stand on a platform while the camera circles around them.
Packages start at $399 for a 3-hour minimum. Each additional hour is $60.
We serve Los Angeles and the surrounding counties. Tell us your venue when you inquire and we will confirm availability.

faq.q: What kinds of events do you work?
faq.a: All of them: weddings, birthdays, corporate events, graduations, holiday parties and more.

faq.q: How much space do you need?
faq.a: Open-air and enclosed booths need about an 8 x 8 ft area, and a 360 booth needs about 12 x 12 ft. We also need one standard power outlet nearby.
